title: Prepare for emerging threats: Rajnath to military
summary: Calls for faster adoption of AI, drones, autonomous systems New Delhi, Oct 23: The Indian military must operate with a long-term strategic vision while remaining prepared for immediate and emerging challenges, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said on Friday, asserting that an integrated approach is crucial to success in modern warfare.
